Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
1. O. REG
No. 558
9-16
5th September 1916.

Sir,
General Tsai Ao is at present a patient at the
Paulun Hospital, Burkill Road, where he is being
attended by Dr. Kreig. He has two rooms, one of
which he occupies himself while the other is
occupied by eight soldiers who act as his body-
guard. They are not in the regulation uniform but
wear a sort of livery.

It is reported that Liang Shih Yi is in
Shanghai and living at No. 23 Gordon Road, the
house of Lieu Yah Sing 刘学问, a well known
Cantonese fantan gambling promoter in the South.

Tuchun Feng Kuo Chang has given instructions
for three plotters for the restoration of the
monarchy now in custody at the Arsenal to be
conveyed to Nanking for trial.

It is reported that the carpenters have
decided to go strike from the 23rd instant.

The painters strike is still going on.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entries in D/Stat 7 Sch. 5.
Seen by C.S.P.

编号
上海工部局。
（印章：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
1. O. REG
第 558 号
9-16
1916年9月5日。

先生，

蔡锷将军目前是宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital，位于伯基尔路）的一名病人，由克里格医生（Dr. Kreig）诊治。他有两间房间，其中一间由他自己居住，另一间则由八名担任其保镖的士兵居住。他们未穿着制式军服，而是穿着一种类似制服的服装。

据报，梁士诒在上海，居住在戈登路23号，即刘学问（Lieu Yah Sing）的寓所。刘学问是华南地区著名的广东番摊赌博 promoter（组织者/头目）。

督军冯国璋已下令，将目前拘押在兵工厂的三名复辟帝制阴谋分子押解至南京受审。

据报，木匠们已决定从本月23日起罢工。

油漆工的罢工仍在进行中。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警察总监上尉。

录入于 D/Stat 7 Sch. 5。
警察总监已阅。
